description: Scholarly paper search. Send a topic or title, or one DOI; returns up to 20 published works with title, authors, year, journal or venue, type, DOI link and citation count from Crossref. Use to find and cite papers. Metadata only, no abstracts or full text. Typical response 1 to 2 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.0099 (USDC, x402).

doi.description: One DOI, such as 10.1038/nature14539. Send query or doi, not both.

from_year.description: Only works published from this year on.

query.description: Topic or title to search for.

rows.description: How many works to return (query mode).

name: quantagentshop_paper_search
title: Paper search
